17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 1536-38 North Halsted Street, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial District
Lot Area: 4,025 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change in order to legalize two (2)
preexisting dwelling units within the existing three-story mixed-use
building at the subject property. The proposed building will continue to
contain 3,651 sq. ft. of retail space at grade and a total of eight (8) dwelling
units above. The height and footprint of the existing building will remain
without change. The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will
not provide off-street parking. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-
1003-EE and 17-13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the
Applicant is seeking to decrease the off-street parking ratio for a Transit
Served Location to 0% (zero parking spaces for eight (8) residential units),
reduce the rear setback for floors containing residential units from 30 ft. to
7 ft., and is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for the
attached plans.

(A) | The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 11,339 square feet (2.82 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 503.13 square feet per D.U.
(8 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 0 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (North/Clybourn
CTA Rail Station). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to
decrease the required number of off-street parking spaces from 4 parking spaces
(50%) to 0 parking spaces (0%).

() — Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 0.1 feet (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: zero (existing)
South Side: 0.1 feet (existing)
c. *Rear Setback: 7 feet (existing)

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback
for floors containing residential units to 7 ft.

(E) Building Height: 36 feet-9 inches (existing)
